protocol_name: LOCO Zero-shot Freeze and Paired Statistics v1
deep_model_loss_handling: Compute loss separately for each seed at each paired residual, then average loss across seeds; do not ensemble predictions.

metrics.RMSE: squared loss; point estimate is sqrt(mean loss)
metrics.MAE: absolute loss; point estimate is mean loss

bootstrap.type: circular moving-block bootstrap over UTC forecast-origin day
bootstrap.effect: history_aware minus cold_start; negative favors history-aware

multiplicity.pooled: single test per horizon × daytype × metric; adjusted p equals raw p
multiplicity.city: Holm across 15 city tests within horizon × daytype × metric

strong_support_rule: Bootstrap 95% CI excludes zero AND Holm-adjusted p < 0.05.
adaptation: Not part of this package. No 30/90/365-day adaptation is allowed before zero-shot statistics are frozen and audited.
